text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, after Agnes Tachyon has a
number of
victories under her belt...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. You still have it on you,
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You know, that thing we won by chance
at the
shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Seeing as you haven't left the academy
since
then, I'd imagine you're still
carrying it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shopping district... won by chance...
Hmmm,
could she be talking about the
hot spring
vacation ticket we got from
that raffle?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, perfect. Then it's settled. We should
head out
to our destination this instant.
choice_data_list: 温泉旅行券なら持ってるけど……

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean "huh?" Wouldn't it
bother you
if you simply held it until it
expired?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What are you waiting for? Come on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure she had complained about
traveling
being nothing but a hassle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Still, I succumb to her pressure, and we
end up
going on that hot spring vacation
together.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Transferring between trains while
carrying around
this heavy luggage was
more bothersome than I
had thought...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Is that so? Hmm...
choice_data_list: 旅行はそういうものだから

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a long journey and multiple
transfers, we
finally arrive at the hot
spring inn.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Phew... They don't call them hot springs
for no
reason.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
How are you feeling? Were you able to

recuperate?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a long and arduous trip, soaking in
a hot
spring is more comfortable than I
imagined.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I see.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Could it be how the muscles relax due to
the
warmth, or is it the healing effects of
the
mineral-rich water? Or perhaps...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No, never mind. In any case, you're
enjoying the
benefits. That's what
matters.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
After this, let's have dinner together. I
already
arranged for the meal to be
delivered to your
room.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: If you'll excuse me, I'll head out first.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, the food is already here! That big
thing
there... is that a spiny lobster?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's said the ample amount of taurine
found in
spiny lobster is beneficial in
alleviating fatigue...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
But taking into account the effort
required to
peel the exoskeleton, it
feels rather meaningless,
no?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, should we start? You peel the
lobster for
me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I ate myself into a coma. The spiny lobster was better than expected, though.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, what about you? You do look
pretty
satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having a fancy meal like this, in a nice
tranquil
place far removed from the
worries of work.
Truthfully, it's very
relaxing.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the tryptophan you ingested earlier
is being
converted into serotonin, thus
causing that
heightened feeling of
happiness.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Or perhaps... hmm...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'm about to ask you something unusual,
if that's
okay with you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With her, unusual questions are the
norm.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Why do you feel, as you say, "satisfied"?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You seem to be struggling for an answer.
In that
case, why don't I take a guess as
to why?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Today, we went through all the trouble
of
packing our luggage and transferring
between
trains, among other things to
get here.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Fundamentally, troubles are nothing
more than
troubles, but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
During this special time frame—this

vacation—these troubles formed part of
a greater
experience...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: And that is what, on the contrary, is serving to further this feeling of happiness. Sound correct?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe what I'm hearing. I sit
there for a
moment, speechless.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you should see the look on your
face.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's true that, up until now, I never
considered
such tedious frustrations
could turn into valuable
experiences.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
But what I've learned in these past three
years has
opened my eyes to an all-new
hypothesis.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's a simple thing to categorize troubles
as
troubles.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's easy to write them off as risks,
discarding the
hidden possibilities they
contain.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Which is why from here on, I shall make
the effort
to discover those possibilities.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
This vacation was another experiment.
And its
conclusion is here before our
very eyes.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In spite of all the troubles we went
through, can
you say that you are
enjoying yourself?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! That's my guinea pig!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I spend the rest of the day engaged in

conversation with Agnes Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During this time together, I feel we have
formed
an irreplaceable bond.
